overview.en:
Skill for searching Bilibili videos and the daily ranking via the public web search endpoint — no login required for top-level results.

Search public Bilibili videos or rankings without a signed-in account. Keep video identifiers and source links so the result is useful as a discovery list.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
搜索哔哩哔哩视频与每日排行榜，无需登录即可获取公开结果。

无需登录即可搜索哔哩哔哩公开视频或排行榜，保留视频标识与来源链接，方便后续查看。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。
